references.title: Google Street View actual Kalevankatu43 and45 fronts, August2024; opened heading324.67/291/350 upper and full-oblique views

observations: The actually opened August2024 southeast frontage is a LOW wooden house, with four tall narrow divided windows in a single row.
Muted ochre horizontal timber cladding, pale grey window casing/lintels, a dark roof cornice and a rough grey-brown stone plinth. The stone/graffiti photographs are not reproduced.
The adjacent tall ornate masonry facade belongs to exact different building45, not43.
limitations: Only the exact complete southeast public street plane is selected. Other side/court/roof roles retain native materials until individually qualified.

Original palette and opening/ornament modules are approximate interpretations of the opened photograph. Native LoD2 dimensions and geometry remain literal; no photograph pixels, graffiti, people or vehicle images are copied.
Both accepted municipal appearance themes lack images for this exact building.
